name: dsh-lineage
description: Content-addressed data and action lineage evidence for DeepSeek Harness

interface.shortDescription: Build and verify content-addressed evidence lineage.
interface.longDescription: Incrementally builds an append-only DAG of artifact, fact, action and report nodes, verifies every referenced object by SHA-256, and emits content-addressed closure reports.
interface.defaultPrompt: Ingest these lineage events, disclose missing or stale evidence, and verify the requested upstream and downstream closure.
